headline: This update fixes item dimming and the auctionable search filter on Classic versions, and resolves an issue with empty slots staying dimmed after a search.

entries.title: Auctionable search filter on Classic Era and TBC
entries.details: The auctionable search keyword now identifies listable items on Classic Era and Burning Crusade by checking for soulbound status, quest items, conjured goods, and other restrictions.

entries.title: Item dimming on Classic clients
entries.details: Fixed an issue where search mismatch and interaction dimming overlays failed to display on Classic versions.

entries.title: Empty slots remaining dimmed after clearing search
entries.details: Slots that became empty while a search was active no longer remain dimmed after clearing the search.
